policy.futureUserVisibleChanges: Extend this shared behavioral contract and both adapters in the same change; document OS-native exceptions explicitly without dropping shared behavior.
policy.scope: Shelf selection and keyboard navigation; native paste, layout and installers retain their separate mandatory acceptance suites.

nativeExceptions.reason: Platform-standard modifier names; shared actions and outcomes remain the same.

nativeExceptions.macos: AppKit materials, system window chrome and native controls
nativeExceptions.windows: Native Windows chrome with Electron-rendered shared layout, controls and icons
nativeExceptions.linux: The shared Electron layout and controls inside the desktop compositor; Wayland compositors own window placement
nativeExceptions.reason: Native platform rendering differs; action placement, content hierarchy, keyboard behavior and outcomes remain shared.

nativeExceptions.macos: Text drag advertises plain text and per-item .txt files together; links offer .webloc copies.
nativeExceptions.windows: Shelf text drag inserts text and shelf image drag exports files. Library card drag adds selected items to folders; Alt-drag exports native file copies (.txt/.url for text/links).
nativeExceptions.linux: Same Electron behavior as Windows; Alt-drag exports .txt files for text and freedesktop .desktop Link files for links.
nativeExceptions.reason: Electron native startDrag exposes files without a simultaneous Unicode-text payload. The explicit Alt gesture preserves direct text insertion and offers both outcomes; native link file types follow each operating system.

nativeExceptions.windows: Clipboard sequence number from the native monitor
nativeExceptions.linux: wl-clipboard data-control watchers on Wayland compositors that offer it (KDE Plasma, wlroots); Xwayland selection bridging on Mutter desktops (GNOME, Ubuntu); X11 selection polling elsewhere, read through xclip when it is installed. Without wl-clipboard on such a Wayland compositor, copies are captured only while ClipBoardLine is focused.
nativeExceptions.reason: Wayland only lets the focused client read the selection unless the compositor offers data-control; Mutter does not, but mirrors the selection to Xwayland. An X11 request to an app that quits mid-transfer can stall Electron's reader for good, so a separate xclip process reads it. Admission, privacy markers and deduplication remain the shared policy.

nativeExceptions.macos: Command+Return pastes into the verified previous editable field.
nativeExceptions.windows: Ctrl+Enter pastes after UI Automation verifies an editable, non-secure field.
nativeExceptions.linux: Ctrl+Enter copies, hides the shelves and returns focus. Under X11 with xdotool it pastes into the same window only while that window is still active; on Wayland the user presses Ctrl+V.
nativeExceptions.reason: Wayland provides no cross-application field inspection or input injection, and X11 offers no portable editable-field check. Copy and focus return are identical; only the final keystroke is the user’s.

nativeExceptions.macos: System hot keys registered by the app
nativeExceptions.windows: System hot keys registered by the app
nativeExceptions.linux: X11 key grabs; on Wayland the desktop GlobalShortcuts portal asks the user to approve them. Desktops without that portal bind system shortcuts to clipboardline --toggle, --search, --library, --copy-latest or --screenshot.
nativeExceptions.reason: Wayland forbids global key grabs by clients; the same five actions remain available through the portal or desktop shortcut commands.

nativeExceptions.macos: A captured copy stays on the pasteboard after the app that copied it quits
nativeExceptions.windows: A captured copy stays on the clipboard after the app that copied it quits
nativeExceptions.linux: When the app that copied an image quits and the clipboard empties, ClipBoardLine serves that image again while its item is still on the shelf, as the desktop clipboard manager does. Text and links, and items deleted, trashed or hidden from the shelf, are never served again.
nativeExceptions.reason: A Linux selection is served by the app that copied it and disappears when it quits (Spectacle quits right after copying a screenshot); macOS and Windows keep the data themselves. Keeping only images covers that case and never undoes a password manager clearing copied text.

nativeExceptions.macos: The line panel floats above other windows until it is dismissed
nativeExceptions.windows: The always-on-top line stays above other windows until it is dismissed
nativeExceptions.linux: On X11 the line stays above other windows. On Wayland the compositor places the line on the monitor in use and it fills that monitor's work area; it is dismissed when another window takes focus (except while its own file dialog or drag is open) and slides in again on the next show; a line found under another window also slides back in. Where the desktop fades new windows in (KWin, Mutter), the reveal starts after that fade.
nativeExceptions.reason: Wayland clients cannot see the pointer, place their windows or request keep-above or skip-taskbar, so a guessed display would size the line for the wrong monitor and a line left open would sit under the activated window while counting as shown. A reveal that starts during the desktop's own window fade is not visible.

nativeExceptions.windows: Electron desktop capture of the current display
nativeExceptions.linux: xdg-desktop-portal Screenshot on Wayland (the desktop may ask once for permission); Electron desktop capture on X11.
nativeExceptions.reason: Wayland clients cannot read the screen directly; the captured image enters the same crop preview.

nativeExceptions.linux: The distribution’s FFmpeg (ffprobe and ffmpeg) inspects, posters and trims to a new H.264/AAC MP4; import explains when FFmpeg is missing.
nativeExceptions.reason: Linux has no system media editing API, and codec licensing keeps FFmpeg a distribution package rather than a bundled binary.

nativeExceptions.macos: Signed in-app update channel; login item
nativeExceptions.windows: Signed in-app installer channel; Electron login item
nativeExceptions.linux: No in-app installer: a newer AppImage, .deb or .rpm replaces the app and keeps data. Launch at login writes an XDG autostart entry.
nativeExceptions.reason: No signed Linux release feed or identity exists yet; distribution package managers own installed files.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: Main-process notices (copy, export, import and error results) and the browsing-shortcut conflict message are shown in the language selected in Settings, using the shared catalog keys, including the "Exported %d · failed %d" and "This shortcut is already used for %@" templates with their real counts and action names.
sharedBehaviors.macos: Notices and the shortcut conflict use L(...) and String(format:) with the shared Localizable.strings catalog.
sharedBehaviors.windows: The renderer looks main-process notices up in the shared catalog, refills numeric templates, and formats the conflict with the catalog key; renderer-ui.test.cjs runs the shipped export through the Export shortcut in Turkish.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: The Library footer and the multi-selection details panel show the number of selected items with the shared "%d selected" catalog entry in the language selected in Settings.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryWindow uses String(format: L("%d selected"), count) for the footer and the multi-selection title.
sharedBehaviors.windows: The renderer formats the count with the shared "%d selected" catalog entry (selectedLabel); renderer-ui.test.cjs checks the footer and the details panel in Turkish, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and English. The Windows folder picker also shows its count with this entry and is checked by the same test.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: Shelf and Library text search ignore accents and character width, so full-width Latin (ＡＢＣ) and half-width katakana (ﾃｽﾄ) are found by typing abc or テスト, with a locale-independent lower case for Turkish I.
sharedBehaviors.macos: Search compares libraryFolded strings: folding with .diacriticInsensitive and .widthInsensitive, then lowercased (LibraryStore.swift).
sharedBehaviors.windows: The renderer fold applies compatibility mapping only to the ideographic space and the Halfwidth and Fullwidth Forms block (plus Hangul compatibility jamo, so half-width ﾡ matches ㄱ, and ￣ mapped to ¯ as on the Mac), strips combining accents and lower-cases without a locale, so ligatures and circled digits stay distinct as on the Mac; shelf-render.test.cjs checks both through the shipped renderer.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: A fetched page title and Open Graph text are decoded with the page's declared character set, in this order: UTF-8 byte-order mark, Content-Type charset, XML declaration (XHTML only), early meta charset; unknown labels are skipped, a meta UTF-16 label means UTF-8, and undeclared bytes that are not UTF-8 are windows-1252, so older windows-1254 / ISO-8859-9 pages show their Turkish letters.
sharedBehaviors.macos: PublicLinkHTMLMetadata.decode follows that order with CoreFoundation IANA names; PublicLinkNetworkTests.testHTMLHonorsDeclaredMetaCharsetAndFallsBackToWindows1252 covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: decodeHTML in lib/network.cjs follows that order with TextDecoder; security.test.cjs covers it.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: A link preview whose Open Graph image is empty or only whitespace has no thumbnail; a valid relative image URL is resolved against the page address.
sharedBehaviors.macos: PublicLinkHTMLMetadata drops a whitespace-only og:image before resolving it; PublicLinkNetworkTests.testWhitespaceOnlyOpenGraphImageGivesNoThumbnailAndValidOneIsKept covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: linkMetadata in lib/network.cjs treats a whitespace-only og:image as missing; security.test.cjs covers it.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: The Link shelf lists links by when they were last copied, falling back to when they were captured, so copying an older link moves it to the first slot; Text and Image shelves stay in capture order. Copying a stored link again records the copy time and keeps its date added, so Newest first and Date added do not change, and it still counts as freshly captured for retention.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryStore.shelfItems orders the .link kind by COALESCE(copied,created) DESC; LibraryStoreTests.testRecapturedLinkMovesLeftAndRenewsTemporaryCaptureWithoutResettingOriginalDate covers a recaptured link.
sharedBehaviors.windows: rowItems in renderer.js sorts the link kind by the newer of lastCopiedAt and createdAt (a link saved by an earlier build had createdAt renewed on a re-copy), and Store.insert keeps createdAt and sets lastCopiedAt and lastCapturedAt when a stored link is captured again, with expire() reading lastCapturedAt before createdAt like macOS prune; shelf-render.test.cjs and media-revision.test.cjs cover it.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: Copying the same image again keeps one Library item: the existing item moves to the front and keeps its pin, name, tags and folders. A different image is a new item.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryStore.captureImage finds a live image with identical original bytes (file size first, then SHA-256), moves it to the front and removes the duplicate clipboard PNG; LibraryStoreTests.testRecopiedIdenticalImageMovesTheExistingItemToTheFrontAndKeepsItsOrganization covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: Store.insert matches a live image by its managed PNG hash and moves it to the front; model.test.cjs 'exact image recopy moves the image in front of another image and preserves saved organization' covers it.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: Pin on a selection that contains both pinned and unpinned items pins every item; only a selection that is already fully pinned unpins.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryStore.toggleFavorite and Line.pinActiveSelection compute one target for the whole selection, matching the action bar, which offers Unpin only when every selected item is pinned; LibraryKeyboardContractTests runs the library-pin-on-a-mixed-selection-pins-all-then-unpins-all scenario of contracts/library-keyboard.json.
sharedBehaviors.windows: Store.modify('pin') pins every selected item when any is unpinned (targetPin); model.test.cjs covers a mixed selection and renderer-ui.test.cjs runs the library-pin-on-a-mixed-selection-pins-all-then-unpins-all scenario of contracts/library-keyboard.json.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: The Library title of a subfolder is the names of all its ancestors and its own name, outermost first, joined with " / " (for example Parent / Child, or Parent / Middle / Child for imported deeper folders), so same-named subfolders of different parents can be told apart; a top-level folder shows only its name.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryModel.title builds the path by walking the whole LibraryCollection.parentID chain (cycle-safe) and shows it as the Library window title; LibraryInteractionTests.testSubfolderTitleIncludesItsParentLikeWindows covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: libraryTitle() in renderer.js shows folderPath() for the folder scope; library-ui.test.cjs checks the toolbar title of a subfolder.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: Restoring items from Library Trash moves focus and selection to the first item that remains in Trash, and clears the details panel when none remain, so the panel never shows Restore for an item that already left Trash.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryModel.restore() queues a keyboard selection that finishKeyboardSelection resolves to the first remaining item after the reload; LibraryInteractionTests.testRestoringFromTrashSelectsTheFirstRemainingItemLikeWindows covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: The restore action calls reconcileLibraryFocus() and renders, which keeps a surviving focus or falls back to the first remaining item; library-ui.test.cjs covers it.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: An item in Library Trash can be copied: the Copy action stays enabled in the action list for a selection in Trash, matching the copy shortcut, while paste, preview, pin and the other editing actions stay disabled until the item is restored.
sharedBehaviors.macos: ActionBarCatalog.keyboardAvailability enables .copy for any selection, as LibraryModel.perform(.copy) already copied it; ActionBarCatalogTests.testCopyStaysAvailableForTrashedItemsWhileEditingActionsDoNot covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: actionCommands() in renderer.js leaves copy out of the actions disabled for Trash items; library-ui.test.cjs checks the action list in Trash.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: An item name is used without its surrounding whitespace, and a name that is only whitespace counts as no name, so the card, the title ordering and the search index fall back to the item's content instead of showing a blank title.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryRecord.displayTitle trims the stored title and ignores a blank one; LibraryStoreTests.testBlankOrPaddedItemNameIsIgnoredOrTrimmedLikeWindows covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: The details command stores the name trimmed and title() falls back to the content for an empty name; model.test.cjs covers a blank and a padded name.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: Removing a folder returns the Library to My library only when the open view is that folder or one of its subfolders; removing any other folder leaves the current view, filters and selection as they are.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryModel.removeFolder(_:) collects the removed folder and its subfolders before the removal and calls changeScope(.saved) only when the open collection is among them; LibraryInteractionTests.testRemovingAnotherFolderKeepsTheOpenViewLikeWindows covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: The confirm handler sets activeFolderRemoved from folderSubtreeContains() and resets the scope only then; library-ui.test.cjs covers an unrelated folder and the active ancestor.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: An item without a name is titled by its content: a text by its first line that is not blank, with surrounding spaces and tabs removed and at most 120 grapheme clusters (lines end at LF or CRLF) and the localized "Untitled note" when every line is blank, a link by its fetched page title or else its host name and the localized "Link" when the stored URL does not parse, so an indented snippet or a long copied URL reads the same on both platforms.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryRecord.displayTitle returns the first non-blank line, trimmed and capped at 120 characters (Characters are grapheme clusters), or L("Untitled note") for an all-blank text, and the metadata title, the URL host or L("Link") for a link; LibraryInteractionTests.testUnnamedItemTitlesAreTheTrimmedFirstLineAndLinkHostLikeWindows covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: title() in renderer.js applies the same rule (t('Untitled note') and t('Link') as fallbacks) to cards, title sorting and best-match ranking; library-ui.test.cjs runs the unnamed item titles scenario.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: A text or a note is saved only while it is at most 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes, so 600,000 Turkish or CJK characters are refused on both platforms and the edit reports an error.
sharedBehaviors.macos: LibraryStore.update checks text.utf8.count and note.utf8.count against TextClipboardWatcher.maximumDataBytes and LibraryModel.flushEdits shows Changes could not be saved.
sharedBehaviors.windows: Store.insert and Store.modify (note, editText, details) count Buffer.byteLength against 1 MiB through sizedText() in model.cjs; model.test.cjs 'a note or edited text over 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes is refused like on macOS' covers it.

sharedBehaviors.behavior: Clear filters is available in the action list only while the Library has a filter to clear (favorites only, a search, a type, a date range, a domain, a tag or a search mode other than all); with no filter it is disabled with the reason "No filters to clear", and with the Library closed it keeps the Library reason.
sharedBehaviors.macos: ActionBarMenuAction.clearFilters requires libraryAvailable and hasLibraryFilters and otherwise names "No filters to clear"; ActionBarCatalogTests covers it.
sharedBehaviors.windows: The clear-filters entry of actionCommands() in renderer.js uses libraryHasFilters() and the shared "No filters to clear" catalog entry; library-ui.test.cjs checks the action list with and without a type filter.
